spec: Surge reopens an action cycle with the movement allowance sampled at the original activation start, preserving once-per-activation Slow timing. Current Root and action-blocking statuses still apply. Completed battles emit no later activation/phase lifecycle events. A technical Surge-chain overflow fails loudly rather than silently ending the activation.
expect: Both authored flight ladder variants retain their correct ranges after Surge and save/restore. Mid-activation Slow waits for the next activation; Root and Stun prevent illegal movement/Surge. End ladders run once, winning Surge stops at battle.end, and a deliberately endless chain throws with no fake outcome. Control changes are confined to removal of trailing phase.end.begin markers (37 pre-change control battles exhibited these).
note: The flight ladder provides two existing authored data instances of the shared refreshed movement allowance. Historical extraction goldens remain evidence of the old implementation; current driver parity and specific correction tests replace incompatible historical expectations. The safety guard is provisionally 256 Surge cycles, an invalid-run exception rather than a gameplay cap. No V1 snapshot compatibility; bump rules version.
